findings.observation: Keyword call has no signature metadata;3.1 keyword syntax fails with XPST0003 before function lookup.

findings.observation: Optional value/radix and default-on-empty require explicit handling;node atomization and strict typed radix checks need independent tests.
Pinned equivalent removes exactly tab,LF,CR,space and underscore. Non-XML spaces and alternate digit families require explicit treatment.
findings.scope: Use reviewed narrow stripping policy;do not silently use broad .NET whitespace

findings.observation: Seven original cases allow FOCA0003 as a size alternative;XdmValue.FromInteger stores long.
findings.scope: An explicit Int64 implementation is compatible with those alternatives;do not infer arbitrary precision
